src: R.A.S./R.T.S. (Pre) 2021
s: Which of the following is not true about the objectives of the Right to Information Act?
o: To promote transparency and accountability n the
To make our democracy work for the people in real
To empower the women and weaker sections of the
x: The Right to Information Act, 2005, is an act to provide for setting out the practical regime of the right to information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority. The basic object of the Right to Information Act is to empower the citizens, promote transparency and accountability in the working of the Government, tackle corruption, and make our democracy work for the people in a real sense. It goes without saying that an informed citizen is better equipped to keep necessary vigil on the instruments of governance and make the government more accountable to the governed. The Act is a big step towards making the citizens informed about the activities of the Government. Hence, statement (3) is not true about the RTI Act. It is essential to mention here that the Right to Information Act, 2005, was amended in 2019.

src: Chhattisgarh P.C.S. (Pre) 2016
s: Which of the following Article of Indian Constitution mentions the 'Doctrine of Pleasure'?
x: Article 310 of the Constitution of India propounds the 'Doctrine of Pleasure'. According to this Article, "Except as expressly provided by this constitution, every person who is a member of a defence service or of a civil service of the union or of an all India service or holds any post connected with defence or any civil post under the union, holds office during the pleasure of the President and every person who is a member of a civil service of a state or holds any civil post under a state, holds office during the pleasure of the Governor of the State.

x: Article 311 provides safeguards to civil servants: no dismissal by an authority subordinate to the appointing one, and an inquiry with a hearing. Article 310 is the Doctrine of Pleasure, the tempting wrong option.
